caption: The drawing shows a figurine-style object with two main figures positioned on a rectangular platform with rounded edges. On the right side, there is a brown and gray donkey standing with a red and yellow patterned blanket or harness across its back. The donkey faces left, looking downward. On the left side, sitting on the same platform, is a human figure with dark skin, a blue and white head wrap, and a yellow shirt paired with dark pants or a draped garment. The figure appears to be sitting on a small bench or box and is holding a stick or rod, with their legs bent and feet flat on the platform. The platform itself is green on the top, resembling grass, and is painted in shades of orange and brown on the sides, with a rough, imperfect base. There are subtle shadows beneath both figures as well as on the platform itself. The background is an off-white or cream color, and the artist's signature, “Berna Sample,” is written in small text near the bottom right of the image.
title: Toy Bank
